entries.title: The Bookstore-Slash-Skate-Shop Next to Ballerina Farm
entries.summary: The first book I sell on our first day in business is a used copy of Fart Proudly: Writings of Benjamin Franklin You Never Read in School, for seven dollars.

entries.title: No More Missionaries: Shiva Naipaul’s Jonestown
entries.summary: There is no better book for understanding Shiva Naipaul, a tragic figure whose name has long been associated with phrases like “unjustly overlooked,” “basically forgotten,” and “younger brother.”
